features.name: Clopper Lake Boat Center
features.description: The seasonal lakefront center rents canoes, single and tandem kayaks, and pedal boats, supports hand-launched private watercraft, sells limited supplies, and provides a paved fishing approach.

features.name: Tire Playground
features.description: A distinctive playground in the Clopper Day-Use Area built around large recycled-tire climbing, crawling, and imaginative-play forms near picnic and lake recreation zones.

details.positionQuality: OpenStreetMap Tire Playground object 1091199192 cross-checked against the official Seneca Creek day-use map
details.imageAlt: Tire Playground at Seneca Creek State Park

features.name: Black Rock Mill
features.description: The roofless stone remains of a historic mill stand beside Seneca Creek in a separate western park area, offering a cultural-landscape stop distinct from Clopper Lake's day-use facilities.
